# Yu OS SDK — Progressive Instructions for AI Coding Agents

You are building or wrapping a **Yu OS App** using `yuos-sdk` (supported in **Python**, **Node.js / TypeScript**, **Go**, and **Rust**).
Read the **Core Rules** and **Minimal Template** below first, then use the **Task Routing Table** to read only the specific document section your task requires.

---

## 1. Core Rules (Always Follow)

1. **Single `operations` declaration**: Declare commands once under `operations` in `app.json`. Command-line (`yu app <id> <cmd>`) and desktop (`yu app <id> --gui`) launches share that declaration. Omit `desktop` in `app.json` unless customizing `.desktop` icon/categories/MIME types.
2. **Entrypoints**:
   - Mark CLI handlers with `@command` (defaults to the function name; takes `args: list[str]` and returns a JSON-serializable value).
   - Mark the desktop entry with zero-argument `@desktop` (`def main():`).
   - If an App only implements `@command` or only implements `@desktop`, the SDK automatically returns an unavailable-surface JSON response when the other surface is launched.
3. **User-intent file access (macOS / Windows model)**:
   - On the CLI, declaring an argument with `"kind": "path"` **automatically grants `fs.read`** on the file passed by the user. Do **not** add a `from-arg` `fs.read` entry to `needs`.
   - In a desktop GUI, `gui.open_file()` **automatically grants `fs.read`** on the user-selected file.
   - Always store App-private state in `app.data_dir()` (requires no permissions).
4. **System AI gate**:
   - Never import OpenAI / Anthropic / provider SDKs directly. Always call `yuos_sdk.ai` (`chat`, `chat_stream`, `embed`, `tts`, `stt`, `imagegen`, `decide`).
   - Add `"ai": {}` at the top level of `app.json` and use string shorthand in `needs` (e.g. `"needs": ["ai.chat"]`).
   - Pass raw `bytes` to `chat(..., images=[...])` and `stt(audio_bytes)` (Yu OS auto-detects PNG/JPEG/WebP and WAV/MP3/Ogg). `tts` and `imagegen` return raw bytes in `.output.audio` and `.output.image`.
5. **Local testing & packaging**:
   - Test locally with `yu app dev ./<dir> <command>` (and `yu app dev ./<dir> --gui`).
   - For local AI testing outside a Yu OS session, set `YUOS_DEV_AI_URL=http://localhost:11434/v1` (plus optional per-slot `YUOS_DEV_AI_CHAT_MODEL`, `YUOS_DEV_AI_EMBED_MODEL`, `YUOS_DEV_AI_TTS_MODEL`, `YUOS_DEV_AI_STT_MODEL`, `YUOS_DEV_AI_IMAGEGEN_MODEL`, `YUOS_DEV_AI_DECIDE_MODEL`, or fallback `YUOS_DEV_AI_MODEL`).
   - Validate with `yu app lint <id>`, package with `yu app pack ./<dir>`, and submit with `yu app submit <file.deb>`.

---

## 2. Minimal Copy-Paste Template

**`app.json`**
```json
{
  "id": "my-app",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "name": {"en": "My App"},
  "runtime": "python",
  "ai": {},
  "operations": {
    "summarize": {
      "label": {"en": "Summarize a file"},
      "args": [{"name": "file", "kind": "path", "required": true}],
      "needs": ["ai.chat"]
    }
  }
}
```

**main.py (Python)** *(For Node.js, Go, or Rust templates, read `yuos-sdk/quickstart.html`)*
```python
from pathlib import Path
from yuos_sdk.ai import chat
from yuos_sdk.app import command, desktop

@command
def summarize(args: list[str]) -> dict:
    text = Path(args[0]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    reply = chat(text, system="Summarize in one sentence.")
    return {"summary": reply.output.text}

@desktop
def main() -> None:
    ...  # Launch your Qt / GTK / Tkinter window
```

---

## 3. Progressive Lookup — Read Only What Your Task Needs (HTML Docs)

Do **not** guess API parameters or manifest fields. Open the exact HTML doc file and `#anchor` section below that matches your current task:

| Task / Feature Needed | Read This HTML File & Anchor | What You Will Find There |
|---|---|---|
| **Install SDK & 4-language starter templates** (Python, Node.js/TS, Go, Rust) | [`yuos-sdk/quickstart.html`](quickstart.html) (`#install`, `#manifest`, `#code`, `#dev`, `#ship`) | Per-language install commands (`pip`, `npm`, `go get`, `cargo add`), complete `main.py` / `index.ts` / `main.go` / `main.rs` templates, and dev/pack/submit commands. |
| **`app.json` manifest fields & `args` / `kind` types** | [`yuos-sdk/api.html#manifest-ref`](api.html#manifest-ref) | All top-level `app.json` fields, `operations` fields, `args[]` schema (`kind`: `text`, `path`, `integer`, `number`, `bool`, `host`, `name`), and `needs` syntax. |
| **Environment variables (`YUOS_DEV_AI_*`)** | [`yuos-sdk/api.html#env-ref`](api.html#env-ref) | Local dev AI endpoints and per-slot model overrides (`YUOS_DEV_AI_CHAT_MODEL`, `YUOS_DEV_AI_EMBED_MODEL`, `YUOS_DEV_AI_TTS_MODEL`, `YUOS_DEV_AI_STT_MODEL`, `YUOS_DEV_AI_IMAGEGEN_MODEL`, `YUOS_DEV_AI_DECIDE_MODEL`). |
| **App entry & OS helpers** (`@command`, `@desktop`, `run`, `data_dir`, `notify`, `clipboard_read/write`, `secret`, `require_permission`) | [`yuos-sdk/api.html#python-mod-app`](api.html#python-mod-app) (or `#node-mod-app`, `#go-mod-app`, `#rust-mod-app`) | PyTorch-style `<dl>` API definitions with exact signatures, `Parameters:`, `Returns:`, `Return type:`, `Raises:`, and examples for each language. |
| **AI model calls** (`chat`, `chat_stream`, `embed`, `tts`, `stt`, `imagegen`, `decide`, `budget`) | [`yuos-sdk/api.html#python-mod-ai`](api.html#python-mod-ai) (or `#node-mod-ai`, `#go-mod-ai`, `#rust-mod-ai`) | Every AI function's parameters (`prompt`, `system`, `images`, `max_units`, `functions`, `tool_turns`), `ModelResponse` output fields, and streaming usage. |
| **Desktop file/folder dialogs & Agent overlay** (`open_file`, `save_file`, `select_folder`, `context`, `open_agent_overlay`) | [`yuos-sdk/api.html#python-mod-gui`](api.html#python-mod-gui) (or `#node-mod-gui`, `#go-mod-gui`, `#rust-mod-gui`) | Native portal file/folder pickers, file-association launch arguments (`gui.context().files`), and triggering the "Ask Yu OS" overlay. |
| **Expose App tools to the Yu OS System Agent (MCP)** | [`yuos-sdk/api.html#python-mod-mcp`](api.html#python-mod-mcp) (or `#node-mod-mcp`) | Setting `schema_version: 2`, declaring `mcp.tools` in `app.json`, binding `@app.tool("<app-id>.<tool>")`, and reading `current_context()`. |
| **Brokered single-file snapshots (`read_file`, `replace_file`)** | [`yuos-sdk/api.html#python-mod-files`](api.html#python-mod-files) (or `#node-mod-files`, `#go-files-go`, `#rust-files-rs`) | Reading and atomically replacing an existing user file (up to 32 MiB) inside an MCP tool with `transform: "brokered-file"`. |
| **Wrap an existing C/C++ binary or adapt an existing Linux GUI app** (Qt, GTK, Electron) | [`yuos-sdk/linux-app-integration.html`](linux-app-integration.html) (`#wrap-binary`, `#gui-app`, `#mcp-agent`, `#pack-submit`) | Step-by-step patterns for wrapping compiled C/C++ binaries with Python/Node/Go/Rust SDK or integrating `yuos-sdk` into an existing Linux desktop app. |
| **App permissions vs. System permissions & AI error codes** | [`yuos-sdk/reference.html`](reference.html) (`#permissions`, `#handle-ai-errors`, `#app-owned-tools`, `#cli-commands`) | Complete table of user-approvable App permissions vs. administrator-gated system permissions, wire error codes, and CLI commands. |
